pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit sub-polygonal geometry with variable spatial area across the flank and neck. Edges demonstrate smooth pixel-level gradients with low-contrast transitions between light and dark fields due to focal blur.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a non-overlapping topological graph. Junction nodes are discernible but lack sharp definition, and pixel thickness remains relatively consistent throughout the visible field.
